goal: Catch and handle wallet database write failures instead of ignoring them silently
Protect users from data loss and state corruption when database operations fail
agreement: Unaddressed objection: reporting corruption on disk full or permissions errors misguides users (vicjuma)
Answered objections on backup handling and error states when writes fail (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval for enforcing consistency between memory and database state (rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it protects persistent wallet data from silent desynchronization with memory
Avoids wallet corruption and unrecorded key derivation or transaction updates
